methods.name: startRecordings
methods.summary: Starts recording a meeting.
methods.description:
Starts recording a meeting. The meeting can be started by an App admin directly,
or a participant with permissions to start a recording, based on the type of
authorization used.

props.name: account_id
props.description: The account identifier tag.

props.name: meeting_id
props.description: ID of the meeting to record.

props.name: allow_multiple_recordings
props.description:
By default, a meeting allows only one recording to run at a time.
Enabling the `allow_multiple_recordings` parameter to true allows you to
initiate multiple recordings concurrently in the same meeting. This allows you
to record separate videos of the same meeting with different configurations,
such as portrait mode or landscape mode.

props.name: audio_config
channel
props.description: Audio signal pathway within an audio file that carries a specific sound source.

props.name: codec
props.description:
Codec using which the recording will be encoded. If VP8/VP9 is selected for
videoConfig, changing audioConfig is not allowed. In this case, the codec in the
audioConfig is automatically set to vorbis.

props.name: export_file
props.description: Controls whether to export audio file seperately

Object containing configuration regarding the audio that is being
recorded.

props.name: file_name_prefix
props.description: Update the recording file name.

props.name: interactive_config
type
props.description: The metadata is presented in the form of ID3 tags.

Allows you to add timed metadata to your recordings, which are
digital markers inserted into a video file to provide contextual information at
specific points in the content range. The ID3 tags containing this information
are available to clients on the playback timeline in HLS format. The output
files are generated in a compressed .tar format.

props.name: max_seconds
props.description:
Specifies the maximum duration for recording in seconds, ranging
from a minimum of 60 seconds to a maximum of 24 hours.

props.name: enabled
props.description:
Controls whether recordings are uploaded to RealtimeKit's bucket. If set to
false, `download_url`, `audio_download_url`, `download_url_expiry` won't be
generated for a recording.

props.name: rtmp_url
props.description: RTMP URL to stream to

props.name: type
props.description: Type of storage media.

props.name: access_key
props.description:
Access key of the storage medium. Access key is not required for the `gcs`
storage media type.

Note that this field is not readable by clients, only writeable.

props.name: auth_method
props.description: Authentication method used for "sftp" type storage medium

props.name: bucket
props.description: Name of the storage medium's bucket.

props.name: host
props.description: SSH destination server host for SFTP type storage medium

props.name: password
props.description:
SSH destination server password for SFTP type storage medium when auth_method is
"PASSWORD". If auth_method is "KEY", this specifies the password for the ssh
private key.

props.name: path
props.description: Path relative to the bucket root at which the recording will be placed.

props.name: port
props.description: SSH destination server port for SFTP type storage medium

props.name: private_key
props.description:
Private key used to login to destination SSH server for SFTP type storage
medium, when auth_method used is "KEY"

props.name: region
props.description: Region of the storage medium.

props.name: secret
props.description:
Secret key of the storage medium. Similar to `access_key`, it is only writeable
by clients, not readable.

props.name: username
props.description: SSH destination server username for SFTP type storage medium

props.name: url
props.description: Pass a custom url to record arbitary screen

props.name: codec
props.description: Codec using which the recording will be encoded.

props.name: export_file
props.description: Controls whether to export video file seperately

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the recording video in pixels

props.name: watermark
position
props.description: Position of the watermark

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the watermark

props.name: url
props.description: URL of the watermark image
Watermark to be added to the recording

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the recording video in pixels

methods.name: startTrackRecording
methods.summary: Starts track recording for a meeting.
methods.description:
Starts track recording for a meeting. Track recording currently records separate
participant audio tracks as WebM files in the RealtimeKit bucket. Video track
recording is in development. For more information, refer to
[Track recording](/realtime/realtimekit/recording-guide/track-recording/).

props.name: account_id
props.description: The account identifier tag.

props.name: meeting_id
props.description: ID of the meeting to record.

props.name: layers
props.description:
Optional audio layer configuration. If omitted, RealtimeKit records
all participant audio using the default file name prefix.

props.name: user_ids
props.description:
Optional list of participant user IDs to record. Selective track
recording (`user_ids`) is in early beta contact support to use this feature.
